name: leftovers
shortEffect: Held: Restores 1/16 (6.25%) holder’s max HP at the end of each turn.
flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is slowly but steadily restored throughout every battle.

name: kings-rock
shortEffect: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Traded on a Poliwhirl: Holder evolves into Politoed. Traded on a Slowpoke: Holder evolves into Slowking.
flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

name: choice-band
shortEffect: Held: Increases Attack by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious headband boosts Attack but only allows the use of one move.

name: lum-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed to cure any status condition or confusion.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from any status condition during battle.

name: sitrus-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to recover 1/4 max HP.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can restore its own HP by a small amount during battle.

name: oran-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to recover 10 HP.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can restore its own HP by 10 points during battle.

name: chesto-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed when asleep to cure sleep.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from sleep on its own in battle.

name: pecha-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed when poisoned to cure poison.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from poisoning on its own in battle.

name: rawst-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed when burned to cure a burn.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from a burn on its own in battle.

name: aspear-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed when frozen to cure frozen.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from being frozen on its own in battle.

name: cheri-berry
shortEffect: Held: Consumed when paralyzed to cure paralysis.
flavorText: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can recover from paralysis on its own in battle.

name: scope-lens
shortEffect: Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit ratio by one stage.
flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

name: shell-bell
shortEffect: Held: Holder receives 1/8 of the damage it deals when attacking.
flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder restores a little HP every time it inflicts damage on others.
